state.heading: Details
state.text: The builder takes a question and a state and returns one request. The lint runs on the question text before anything is sent and refuses comparisons, counts and rankings because one record cannot answer them. The request pins the model version so that drift is a red verdict rather than a silent change. All of this happens in code with no model call, which is why it can run in a test.
state.page_purpose: Primer that builds understanding before the Hub
